scope: Independent news-source/time/identity/privacy audit plus frozen cohort and raw minute input integrity; no strategy or primary-catalyst validation

findings.description: No provider guarantee of historical revision snapshots. Missing/malformed/late or reversed updated timestamps quarantine metadata; any observed global ID payload conflict quarantines all versions. Passing flags only metadata_ready_for_review.

SDK says sort by updated; created-vs-updated start/end filtering is not formally specified. A controlled single ALT article boundary probe supports updated filtering, but is not a complete contract guarantee. Missing historical created-time coverage cannot be ruled out;157 empty windows are source_missing, never no-event.
Strict close<created<open and created<=updated<open. Independent future1ns, equality, unknown offset, bad dates/offsets and missing/late updated tests pass.

Exact symbol tags required; same ID maps across windows; full payload differences quarantine all versions; identical duplicates preserve row indexes/counts. Symbols are provider-related/mentioned tags, not proof the article is the issuer catalyst.
Initial code accepted any string headline. Added nonempty strip requirement and regression test; blank/nonstring headline now quarantined. No actual cohort count changed.

Downloader assembler uses datetime microseconds; independent exact-nanosecond audit verified all99,272actual bars are exact whole minutes within their request windows and nonduplicated. Downstream market get_bar now also rejects nonzero nanosecond minute offsets.

Public article evidence has timestamps, hashes, URLs and derived hints; no raw headline,summary orcontent fields. review-material-private.json and raw-news/raw-bars remain excluded from public package.
